about: docs/protocol.md, Authentication: one known answer. Proofs are lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the secret's UTF-8 bytes; client_proof of "client:<Ns>:<Nc>:<client role>:<client name>", server_proof of "server:<Ns>:<Nc>:<server role>:<server name>", session_key K of "session:<Ns>:<Nc>", osc_token the first 32 hex characters of HMAC-SHA256 keyed with K's hex string, of "osc". A test secret, never a pair's.
